text:
claire.partnerships: Quick thread  planning a rehearsal for the SI readiness playbook + joint marketplace listing demo. Goal: run a 45m dry-run Wed so SIs can rehearse co-listing and private deploy flows. Need owners for playbook script, lab harness, cert gate, and asset delivery.

omar.enablement: I can take the playbook script & badge criteria. Thinking one-page runbook + 12-step demo script. Will sketch by Tue.

rachel.si: From the SI side, request a 'co-listing checklist' that covers required metadata, pricing hints, and support contact. Also need a short demo that shows model scale-up on Dedicated.

kevin.ops: Ops constraints: hosted sandboxes 48h provisioning, Dedicated pool scheduled maintenance Sun 03:00 UTC. If you want same-week rehearsal use offline bundle or reserve early. I can open CAP ticket.

dina.training: Is got an updated facilitator pack (slides, 2 labs, proctor checklist). Proctor: record the demo + 10-min live Q&A. Pass = functional demo + metadata submitted. Im fine owning proctor SOP.

claire.partnerships: Ownership draft: Omar -> playbook + badges; Dina -> facilitator pack + proctor SOP; Rachel -> SI sample metadata & mentor list; Kevin -> sandbox ops ticket. Can folks confirm?

rachel.si: Confirmed. I'll drop 3 mentor emails and a sample metadata template by EOD. Example snippet I'll share: ```yaml
listing:
  name: "Redwood SI - private-demo"
  contact: "rachel@si-example.com"
  env: "dedicated+fallback"
```

omar.enablement: Nice. I'll include that snippet in the script and map demo steps to badge rubrics (Observer / Verified / Certified).

kevin.ops: Opening CAP-11022 for sandbox reservations; ETA 48h. If you need staging DNS, ping me. deploy-bot: heads-up?

deploy-bot: Reminder  Dedicated maintenance Sun 03:00 UTC - provisioning windows affected.

dina.training: I'll schedule a 45m dry-run Wed 11am PT and invite the mentors + SIs. Will upload facilitator pack to the partner repo before the meeting.

claire.partnerships: Great. Two asks before dry-run: 1) Rachel, metadata + mentors by EOD; 2) Omar, playbook script by Tue 5pm PT. I'll draft a short legal annex about demo recordings and share for quick review.

rachel.si: On it. Thanks all.
